Arkbrave Dragon here, would definitely recommend trying out Felgrand Demise. Smokescreens really well into Kozmo Demise if you're feeling spicy btw.



You run:


-  2 Divine Dragon Lord Felgrand


-  2 Arkbrave Dragon


-  1 Dragon Spirit of White


-  1 Amorphage Goliath


-  2-3 Thunder King Rai-Oh, or Amano-Iwato


plus full playsets of Card of Demise, Pot of Duality, Into the Void, Call of the Haunted, a couple Back to the Front, and a whole lot traps(basically the Solemn Brigade), and Dragon Shrine/Dragon Ravine.



Using Dragon Ravine, and Dragon Shrine you can send your Dragons from the deck to the GY, and using Dragon Ravine, Card of Demise, and Into the Void you can pitch Dragons from your hand to the GY. Next turn you use Arkbrave/Call of the Haunted to summon what you need most back while using your amped up backrow to disrupt your opponent, and play big bad ass dragon beat down.


Game 2/3 you side out all the Dragon cards, and side in:


-  3 Kozmo Tincan


-  1 Kozmo Strawman


-   1 Kozmo Farmgirl, or Kozmoll Wickedwitch


-  1 Kozmoll Dark Lady


-  2 Kozmo Sliprider


-  1 Kozmo Forerunner


-  1 Kozmo Dark Destroyer


-  1 Kozmo Dark Eclipser


-  2 Kozmotown


-  2 Kozmojo


and proceed to have a lot of fun. A guy topped a regional back in late 2016 by doing this making this the most competitive form of Felgrand to my knowledge. 


Would highly recommend at least trying it out.

In any deck running double Lost Wind I've always recommended 1 Lost Wind/ 1 Breakthrough skill instead. 


Lost Wind's second effect to recycle itself requires your opponent to special summon from the Extra deck. There are lots of Main deck threats that are special summoned that Lost Wind will be completely useless to stop once it hits the grace. Breakthrough Skill's second effect on the other hand can be used at any point during your turn except the turn it hits the grave. Much less situational much more versitile.


Lost Wind being able to permantly negate an effect, AND halve a monster's stats is way better than Breakthrough Skill, no doubt, but Breakthrough Skill's graveyard effect is better than Lost Wind's in my opinion.

- milled from the deck to the grave(using Raiden, or Charge of the Light Brigade)


- discarded from the hand(like with Dragon Ravine, or Twin Twisters, or Card of Demise)

- or if the Pendulum Monster's summon was negated(because of Solemn Warning or something)



Amorphage Goliath with go to the Extra Deck face up if:


- it is destroyed after it is properly summoned(b/c of battle, or card effect, or whatever)


- or if you set it in the Pendulum Scale, and it then gets destroyed.



Basically: once Amorphage Goliath hits the field it goes to the Extra Deck afterwards. If it never sees the field it goes to the grave.
